title: Consecutive Numbers Sum
summary: Given an integer n, determine the count of ways to express n as the sum of one or more consecutive positive integers.
statement: Given an integer n, determine the count of ways to express n as the sum of one or more consecutive positive integers.
constraints: Count representations of n as one or more consecutive positive integers.
reference_solution:
def consecutive_sum_count(n):
    answer=0;length=1
    while length*(length-1)//2<n:
        remaining=n-length*(length-1)//2
        if remaining%length==0:answer+=1
        length+=1
    return answer
